subject.title: feat(ios): tap-to-expand link previews in chat transcript

question: Should the Apple link-preview slice proceed with URLSession post-connection address validation once the source blockers and real-proof gap are fixed, or should it pause for a stricter network-boundary design?
rationale: The PR is maintainer-labeled and discloses a platform-specific DNS-rebinding limitation; automation can identify code defects but cannot decide the acceptable Apple network boundary.

options.title: Fix and prove this slice
options.body: Repair the review findings, keep fetches user-gesture-gated, and require redacted native app proof before merge.

options.title: Accept source-only proof
options.body: A maintainer could intentionally accept source and unit-test evidence for the network boundary, but the native user flow would remain unproven.

options.title: Pause for boundary redesign
options.body: If the URLSession rebinding limitation is not acceptable, pause this platform slice until a stricter Apple fetch design is chosen.

recommendation.title: Fix and prove this slice
recommendation.body: Repair the review findings, keep fetches user-gesture-gated, and require redacted native app proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The mobile polish issue, Android sibling, and this PR point to steipete as the best available owner for the product and security-boundary call.
